one_line: Maharaja of Tripura whose Sylhet victory coin proclaimed him ‘Conqueror of Sylhet’ amid turbulent frontier wars with Bengal and Arakan.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, lean but well-toned build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed pointed moustache with a short goatee, dark expressive eyes with a steady, calculating gaze; default expression is composed and dignified, with a slight determined frown.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied back into a low knot at the nape, front kept smooth with a slight middle part; he wears a modest conical Tripura-style turban in deep maroon with a narrow golden band and a small white feather tucked on the left side.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length cotton angarkha-style tunic in rich off-white with a subtle woven pattern and overlapping front tie, edged with a thin maroon and gold border; over this, a deep maroon silk patka-sash is wrapped firmly around his waist with the loose end hanging to the left, embroidered with small gold geometric motifs; his lower garment is a straight, slightly tapered cotton dhoti in muted mustard yellow, pleated neatly and brought between the legs for ease of movement; a short, sleeveless quilted cotton coat in dull olive green, lightly padded and hip-length, sits over the tunic as practical light armour without metal plates; he wears simple brown leather strapped sandals; jewellery is restrained but royal—small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thickness gold necklace with a round coin-like pendant, and a plain gold ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved single-edged sword (similar to an early talwar) with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a plain dark brown scabbard hanging from his maroon waist-sash, plus a small silver Tripura coin held between his fingers or tucked at his belt to evoke his Sylhet victory issue.

ref_desc: Amar Manikya is a medium-built king in his early 40s with a medium-brown oval face, black hair in a low knot under a deep maroon conical turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, olive quilted vest, mustard dhoti, maroon sash, and carrying a curved sword with a dark brown scabbard plus a small silver coin.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Amar Manikya, historically grounded in late 16th-century Tripura: a medium-built man in his early 40s with a medium-brown oval face, high cheekbones, sharp nose, dark focused eyes, a neat pointed moustache with short goatee, and thick black hair tied into a low knot under a deep maroon conical turban with a narrow gold band and small white feather on the left. Show him in an off-white knee-length cotton angarkha with a subtle woven texture and thin maroon-and-gold edging, over which sits a hip-length sleeveless quilted cotton coat in dull olive green as light armour, plus a firm deep maroon silk waist-sash (patka) embroidered with tiny gold geometric motifs, its loose end hanging on the left. His lower garment is a straight, slightly tapered mustard-yellow cotton dhoti, neatly pleated and brought between the legs, and he wears simple brown leather strapped sandals. Add restrained royal jewellery: small gold stud earrings, a single medium gold necklace with a round coin-like pendant, and a plain gold ring on his right hand. His signature weapon is a long, slightly curved single-edged sword with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, in a plain dark brown scabbard on his maroon sash, and he also holds or displays a small silver coin to evoke his Sylhet victory issue. Use a palette of off-white, deep maroon, mustard yellow, olive green, and dark brown, and present front, side, and back views emphasizing consistent face, hair, costume, and sword details in a dignified, era-accurate style.
